items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: 'I'd Do Almost Anything For You', by Claude Hopkins, Bob Williams and Joe Davis. So I saw Claude, and I said ...'

ctx.x: Claude Hopkins came by the theatre, and said, "Hey, Tom give me that number" -- that was next week, see, and I said, "No, I put it on the shelf, we played it enough." So the producer says, Addison Carey, he's a producer, he said, "Yeah, give it to Claude, and Claude will play it down the Roseland Ballroom".
So me, like a dummy, went out and give him the orchestration. About six months later, 'I'd Do Almost Anything For You', by Claude Hopkins, Bob Williams and Joe Davis. So I saw Claude, and I said ...
